key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: Frequency in seconds at which the background collector updates metrics.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: Display mode in the top bar: 'sessions' (Claude % · AGY %), 'tokens' (daily tokens/steps), or 'compact' (% · %).

key.name: claude-token-daily-threshold
key.description: Threshold for daily Claude tokens before showing warning styling (0 disables).

key.name: antigravity-step-daily-threshold
key.summary: Daily Antigravity step count warning threshold
key.description: Threshold for daily Antigravity steps before showing warning styling (0 disables).

key.name: claude-path-override
key.description: Custom directory path for Claude data. If empty, defaults to ~/.claude.

key.name: antigravity-path-override
key.description: Custom directory path for Antigravity data. If empty, defaults to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli.
